title: Meeting time. Thoughts on the unavoidable "AI service" scam and my idea to counter it.
author: EverythingBOffensive
selftext:
Example, you want the simplest form of image to 3d app or music generator, texture generator etc.

Your search results: "FREE AI IMAGE TO 3D!!!", they let you go through the whole process of configuring and shit. Then hit you with "Sign in with google"

or "Woops you have 1 credit remaining and it costs 2 credits, might as well susbcribe!"

Stuff of that nature.

I think its toxic, and its copy-pasted under different domain names by the same group of scammers. It floods the first 10 pages of results anywhere. I don't bother with youtube anymore, that's just videos encouraging you to get fucked.

So I put these "AI" apps to the test and found out most can be done without ai actively working around the clock to get your 3d models made. it won't cost a penny to generate results once the app is made as long as you have enough space on your drive. I'm fixing to put all this shit out for free, public access, yeah its ai, created by ai, that is, and built to work in python on my end. I have 2d to 3d mesh prototypes, fbx to glb conversion with no fucking paywall! yeah, stuff i looked for and reached a dead end, I'm not just pulling this stuff out now. Everything I need I tell ai to make it and then its done.

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body:
Yeah I agree after messing with a few of those website I started create and release all my own workflow and tool/apps for one time payment (cheap) or pay what you want just depending on how much time it took me to set up/make 

I have a few in the works that will replace a lot of these scammy sites I just wish more people would be like this instead of falling for the traps, I had one user on here in this sub actually defending a few of them when I was advertising a cheaper alternative lol I wish people would wake up and stop paying for a monthly subscription twice + credits its insane the greed of some of the sites out there
